summary: Verified the Quotex-style persisted OTC candle store end-to-end. Backend: 13/13 pytest checks pass on /api/market/candles — latest page returns 500-501 candles with has_more=true and last candle == current minute bucket, times strictly ascending & unique & bucket-aligned; pagination via before= is contiguous (older newest == first_time - tf, no overlap/gap) and byte-identical when repeated; restart persistence confirmed (sudo supervisorctl restart backend → historical page for same before= is EQUAL pre vs post, and 'candle store ready in 0.3-0.6s' appears in backend logs); timeframes 5,300,3600,14400,86400 all return valid OHLC data with time % tf == 0; tf=7 → 400; unknown symbol → 404; tf=5 depth walks back to has_more=false within ~2 days as designed; 5m aggregation matches five 1m candles (open==first.open, high==max(highs), low==min(lows), close==last.close). Frontend (fresh /api/auth/register token injected into localStorage, /demo-trade): trade-chart renders; per-pair TF memory works — EURUSD set to 5m + GBPUSD set to 15s both persisted in localStorage.bfg_tf_map ({EURUSD_OTC:300, GBPUSD_OTC:15}) and correctly restored when tabs are toggled (rail label shows 5m/15s accordingly); live price tag updates in real time via socket (1.10962 → 1.10992); UP trade placement works (trade-badge appears on chart with $1.00 countdown); chart pan-left triggers older-history pagination — captured 2 sequential /api/market/candles?...&before=... network requests with contiguous 500-candle steps (before=1785157020 then before=1785127020, delta==30000s==500m*60), and chart correctly renders candles back to ~17h ago (far beyond the initial 500-candle window).

issues: The 'chart-loading-older' chip flashes too briefly to be reliably observable (older request completes in ~50-150ms) — functionally correct but low visibility. Consider a small minimum-visible-duration (e.g. 250ms) so users actually see the 'Loading history…' feedback on fast connections.

critical_code_review_comments: candle_store.run() swallows exceptions silently (except Exception: logger.exception + falls back to in-memory). Consider surfacing this in a /api/health or /api/market/status endpoint so operators can spot a store-init failure without tailing logs.
market_routes._base_period is duplicated conceptually with BASE_PERIODS in market.py — a single mapping module would avoid drift if base periods are ever changed.

The tf=5 window query (lo = hi - tf*limit) is a fixed-width slice — this is elegant but does NOT skip potential gaps in stored 5s candles. In steady-state this is fine (flush every 2s) but immediately after restart there can be a small forming-bucket gap. Acceptable given the requirements, just noting.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (chart load, per-pair TF memory across pair swap, live tick update, UP trade placement, older-history pagination via 2 contiguous before= API calls all verified)

test_credentials: Fresh users registered on the fly via POST /api/auth/register (returns JWT directly). No seeded creds needed. Existing local users still: admintest@test.com / AdminPw123! (2FA), twofa1@test.com / Passw0rd123 (2FA).
seed_data_creation: None — used dynamic register-and-inject-token pattern to bypass 2FA for chart tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend candle store is stable and paginated correctly across restarts (verified via test_candle_store.py::TestRestartPersistence). If you need to add tests: SUPPORTED_TFS = (5,10,15,30,60,120,180,300,600,900,1800,3600,14400,86400); BASE_PERIODS stored = (5,60,14400,86400); every other tf aggregated in SQL by market_routes.py. Fresh users get 2FA ON by default — for any chart/trade UI tests it is far easier to POST /api/auth/register (returns token directly) and inject bfg_token + bfg_user into localStorage than to walk the 2FA flow. To force a specific starting timeframe on /demo-trade, seed localStorage.bfg_tf_map before navigation. The 'chart-loading-older' chip is real but flashes very quickly on the local backend (~50-150ms round trip); the reliable way to verify pagination is via network monitoring for /api/market/candles?...&before=... requests (page.on('request', ...)).
rca of the issue: N/A — no bug found. All 8 requested acceptance criteria met: (1) shape+has_more+ordering, (2) pagination contiguity+consistency, (3) restart persistence identical, (4) 14 timeframes valid + 400/404 handling + tf=5 depth cap, (5) 5m == 5x1m aggregation correctness, (6) chart loads + pan-left lazy-loads older via before= requests, (7) per-pair bfg_tf_map memory across pair switches (EURUSD→5m, GBPUSD→15s round-trip), (8) live tick continues + 5s/1m UP trade places successfully and renders badge on chart.
